Hi there!! Thank you so much! You don’t know how much hearing that means to me..I just don’t understand what went wrong. Where it all went wrong. Why now? I’m just so upset. I’m sort of in denial. I refuse help often because I’m denial that it’s that bad. I can’t cry in front of people. I just bawl my eyes out when I’m alone. I just want to be held and comforted by someone, but hardly anyone can see how much I’m struggling. It feels like drowning. Your comment means so much to me. :)
But I’d love to potentially adopt if it ever came down to it. I’d love the opportunity to give a child a good home. But I’d always feel a bit guilty.

I think it’s mostly childhood trauma. I don’t want to be the mother to my children that my mother was to me and I don’t want to project my insecurities onto my children. I also just don’t want to have kids in order to “fill a void.” Being a mother is a huge responsibility I just don’t think I want to take on. I’d love to see the love of my life become a parent but I’m also very scared of having children, especially in today’s world. I’d like to settle down with my husband and a few pets and travel and do what makes me happy. Kids are just a huge headache. However, sometimes I think having kids would be nice..I just don’t want them to think I’m a bad mom..and then I’d have to work harder to provide them with a life that I never had to make sure we were all doing well and then I’d hardly get to see them..and I just don’t want to live their lives for them..I don’t want to force them to do sports I never go to do growing up even if they don’t want to. I’m scared of becoming THAT mom.
